findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.assumptions: The port name 'COM8' is not attacker-controlled. If the port name is derived from user input, this could be a vulnerability.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: Opening the serial port with a hard-coded port name
findings.assumptions: The port name 'COM8' is not attacker-controlled. If the port name is derived from user input, this could be a vulnerability.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.untrusted_source: Data read from the serial port
findings.trigger: Emitting data read from the serial port
findings.assumptions: The data read from the serial port is not processed or interpreted in a way that could lead to command execution. If the data is used in a command execution context, this could be a vulnerability.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.untrusted_source: Error string from the serial port
findings.trigger: Outputting the error string to the debug log
findings.assumptions: The error string is not processed or interpreted in a way that could lead to command execution. If the error string is used in a command execution context, this could be a vulnerability.
